title: Chelsea Face a Depth Test Without Joao Pedro Again
body:
Chelsea are missing Joao Pedro again for Saturday, and the setback puts their dependence on him back under the microscope [S1]. The absence stings most when the player missing is the one everyone leans on.

BBC Sport argues that Joao Pedro may be the most important player in the side, weighing up what his availability means for the team [S1]. The same outlet also reported that Chelsea have warned staff to be careful about what they reveal through Fantasy Premier League, after his injury appeared to leak through team selections [S2].

The recent results are not comfortable. In the last five league matches, Chelsea have won three, lost two and drawn none, taking 9 points from a WWLWL run [ST1]. They have scored 9 and conceded 4 across that spell [ST1]. Those figures show a team that can win games but still gives away enough to make every defeat sting. With a key player out, there is little room for error.

This is where squad depth gets tested, and that is where seasons are quietly decided. A thin bench gets exposed fast when a player of this stature drops out, and the manager now has to show the rest of the group can carry the weight.

The Touchline Take: how the squad copes without him will define the next month.
